name: market
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. This input is an exact orthographic production geometry blockout, NOT a mood image. Materialize it as a realistic hand-crafted ancient southern Xinjiang oasis-town map sprite. Preserve the input camera, framing, every major outer boundary and especially the three lowest footprint corners PIXEL EXACTLY. Do NOT rotate, re-project, tilt, enlarge, narrow, or reposition the blockout. Its ground axes are exactly +0.5 and -0.5 slopes, yaw45 elevation30, required for grid assembly. Add fine weathered ochre adobe, local pale stone foundation, honest timber grain and carved wood screens. Restrained highly detailed realistic historic strategy-game art; no plastic/toy look. Upper-left light, tiny lower-right contact shadow. Keep real transparent RGBA outside silhouette. No text, numbers, guide marks, border, watermark, people, animals, modern objects, landscape, or thick floating display slab. Ground is a flat thin contact surface. All new detail stays WITHIN the guide silhouette. Footprint front-to-side lengths exactly 5:4. Make this exact four-post rectangular geometry into one oasis bazaar stall. Top plane is taut woven tan awning with small muted rust geometric woven strips; retain exact awning plane orientation and size. Plain timber posts, small pots, copper bowls, folded rugs on low counter beneath within footprint. Ground remains thin rectangular contact surface. Lowest vertices left(208,580), front(830,891), right(1328,642).
notes: 合入前审核第1轮返修：用精确5×4实心灰盒重出，逐张查看原图与灰底alpha合成；三底角量点轴向/比例均在既有公差内，alpha>200底边OLS为+0.52833/-0.51592。只裁切、等比缩放、扩透明边，未调阈值或变形。巴扎器物与织物仍为地域原创组合。

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读取可见底面角点，约±4px；后角遮挡，非3D实测
geometry_qa.corner_basis: 可见外包络；OLS独立拟合alpha>200长直底边

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize with pixel rounding
unmasked paste into transparent canvas; no repaint/warp/alpha threshold
